A+D.note: Bayer recalled A+D Diaper Rash Cream in February 2017 for trace diethyl phthalate, on a product labelled phthalate free. That recall is closed and nine years old, so under rule 5.2 it is informational. Two things about it are not. The recalled item was the Cream and this is the Ointment, but diethyl phthalate is a fragrance solvent and this ointment carries undisclosed Fragrance, which is a shared mechanism rather than a sibling coincidence. And it was an adverse finding on the brand's own representations: the FDA label and the Amazon listing still read PHTHALATE-FREE today, so under rule 5.1 nothing this brand says about itself can carry a pass without third party proof. The earlier FDA match on this brand was A & D Engineering, a blood pressure monitor maker with no connection to the ointment, and has been discarded.

Nuna.note: NHTSA recall 24C-002, opened December 2024, covers 608,786 RAVA convertible seats built July 2016 to October 2023, whose front harness adjuster can stop clamping when debris gets into the teeth. Nuna did publish a remedy: a kit with a new seat pad, a stiff brush and a screwdriver to clean the adjuster, with owner letters mailed 14 February 2025. It published no independent testing of the fix. Multiple class actions filed through 2025 argue the remedy is inadequate because it cleans rather than replaces the mechanism, and none had been dismissed or settled as of February 2026. Flame retardants are not the issue here and the brand is genuinely strong on those; this is a mechanical safety finding on the convertible seat.

ByHeart.note: Checked recall records on 2026-09-09. November 2025 nationwide recall of all lots during an infant botulism outbreak (48 infants, 17 states; declared over 2026-02-26). FDA matched C. botulinum in a formula sample to a supplier's organic whole milk powder and found no explanatory deficiencies at ByHeart's plants. Back on market since June 2026 under an FDA reviewed return plan. Recalled lots carry use by dates into December 2026. Also an August 2023 FDA warning letter over Cronobacter handling.
ByHeart.source: fda.gov press announcements and recall notices

HiPP.note: Checked recall records on 2026-09-09. 2021 Able Groupe FDA recall of imported products labeled as infant formula, including this brand: iron below the US minimum of 1 mg per 100 kcal and no premarket notification filed. Tubby Todd.note: Checked on 2026-09-10. No recall or FDA action. A 2022 Proposition 65 notice over DEHP in the vinyl travel bag of the Travel Kit settled in 2023 with a reformulation commitment and a civil penalty; packaging of a sibling kit, not the wash. Majority owned by NexPhase Capital since July 2022.

The Honest Company.note: Checked on 2026-09-10. Record across the baby and bath lines: 2015 nationwide wipes mold recall, 2017 baby powder recall for microorganisms, January 2021 Health Canada recall of two bubble bath lots for Pluralibacter gergoviae; a 1.55 million dollar settlement in June 2017 over 'SLS free' claims on cleaning products, and a reported 7 million dollar settlement the same year over 'natural' claims across 41 products. A 2020 Proposition 65 notice over lead in the diaper rash ointment. No action names the current fragrance free shampoo and body wash.

Babyganics.note: Checked on 2026-09-10. Three distinct product recalls in five years, which rule 5.2 scopes to the brand: April 2022 chamomile bubble bath (two lots, Pluralibacter gergoviae), and February 2025 Kids SPF 50+ Totally Tropical spray and rollerball sunscreens (about 943,000 units, a solvent that should not be present). The Mayhew class action over 'mineral based', 'natural' and 'organic' claims, which named the shampoo, settled for 2.215 million dollars with final approval November 2018.

Hello Bello.note: Checked on 2026-09-10. McGee v. Hello Bello Consumer Wellness, filed December 2024 and removed to C.D. Cal. in February 2025, alleged the 'hypoallergenic' claim on the Premium Baby & Kids Shampoo & Body Wash was false because the label carries glucosides and a betaine relative; the federal docket terminated August 2025 with no public disposition found, so it stays an allegation at caution. The company went through Chapter 11 in late 2023 and was bought by Hildred Capital, now run under Hyland's Naturals.
